    well_names = []
    for col in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]:
        for row in range(1, 9):
            well_names.append(col + str(row))
    for i, well_name in enumerate(well_names):

            name=f"library {i+1}",
            description=f"Sequencing library {i+1}",
            display_color="#FF0000"
        )

    dest_tube = tubes["A1"]
